//: Type-checks this package's JSX runtime and its own example against `tsc --strict` -- see the README's 'JSX' section. Needs a built native addon first (`npm run build:debug`), since `js/app/runtime.ts` type-imports `./index`'s own generated `index.d.ts`. `npm run typecheck:jsx` resolves `tsc` from the hoisted `typescript@^5.9` devDependency (not the separate `typescript@6` `@napi-rs/cli` carries as its own nested dependency) -- this config is only ever exercised against 5.9, so a behavior difference in TS 6 (e.g. around the local-vs-global `JSX` namespace this runtime exports) would not be caught here.
